name: amfx-nasdaq-dotcom-roundtrip
description: amFX reproduction (21DEC22 p3): NASDAQ Composite 1996-2004 showing the dot-com bubble round trip. Line chart with LTCM bailout reference level (~1500) and area fill. Key insight: NASDAQ was still at ~3000 going into 2001 (huge bubble premium still to unwind), unlike current bubble stocks that have already round-tripped. Source: amFX 21DEC22 newsletter (Brent Donnelly, Spectra Markets).
source:
# =============================================================================
# AMFX REPRODUCTION: NASDAQ 1996-2004 DOT-COM BUBBLE ROUND TRIP
# =============================================================================
# Reproduces page 3 chart from amFX 21DEC22 newsletter.
# NASDAQ Composite line chart showing the full dot-com bubble cycle.
# LTCM bailout level ~1500 as reference line. Area fill shows the
# excess above the pre-bubble level. Round trip completed ~2002.
# Point: current bubble stocks (AMZN, ARKK) already round-tripped,
# unlike NASDAQ in early 2001 which still had massive premium.
# =============================================================================

# =============================================================================
# DATA: NASDAQ Composite from FRED (daily)
#  to get full history back to 1971
# =============================================================================
nasdaq_src = economic_indicators(series_id='NASDAQCOM')()
nasdaq = ffill(nasdaq_src.result)

# Time index
idx = index()

# =============================================================================
# CHART 1: NASDAQ Composite with LTCM Reference
# =============================================================================
xy_lines(
    title='NASDAQ Dot-Com Bubble: How Far Did It Have to Fall?',
    category='NASDAQ Dot-Com',
    y_axis_label='NASDAQ Composite',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=0,
    area=True,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='NASDAQ Composite', color=Color.Orange, area=true)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=1500.0, title='LTCM Bailout Level (~1500)', color=Color.Blue, dash_style=DashStyle.Solid)
    ]),
    order=0
)(idx, nasdaq)
